run_streaming_inference: run the streaming inference example to generate text token by token from a prompt
create_chameleon_model: create a ChameleonInferenceModel instance with model weights and tokenizer paths
stream_text_generation: stream text generation results token by token using the model stream method
decode_generated_tokens: decode generated token tensors back to readable text using decode_text
review_main_function: review the main function that initializes the model and streams text output
